Parsl is not highly promoted and it doesn’t have many sexy hipster deisgn patterns or, indeed, much graphic design about its internet present. However, it turns out to solve a lot of my problems. Parsl originated from the academic and high-performance computing community, motivated by the need for a scalable, flexible way to orchestrate complex scientific workflows without leaving the Python ecosystem. The goal was to address the growing demands of “big data” and the plateauing of sequential processing power by enabling researchers to scale from a laptop to a supercomputer with minimal changes to their code.
